text:
Carmen G: heads-up from AE: prospect asking for an "enterprise-flex" bundle — committed tokens + per-route SLOs + on-demand dedicated during planned blackouts. they want a single exhibit for the pilot. can product ops bake a readiness checklist?

Theo M: quick ops questions: what's expected upgrade latency to dedicated? warm-node hours required? pre-warm costs need to be captured in pricing.

Ivy L: docs ask: entitlements table per route, example invoices, and an AE playbook. customers will ask "what happens if route SLOs miss" — need clear credit math.

Marcus P: legal high level: can't promise hard per-route latency without reserved capacity. we should offer tiered SLOs (best-effort vs guaranteed) and attach an exhibit that ties guaranteed SLOs to prepaid reserved capacity. liability cap = fees paid last 12 months.

contracts-bot: auto: recommend: 1) reserved capacity clause for guaranteed SLOs; 2) escalation flow for blackout activation; 3) approval required for on-prem connectors. will draft skeleton.

billing-bot: note: to support on-demand dedicated we need API for conversion + pro-rated billing + refundable warm-deposit handling. tag: engineering-billing.

Carmen G: proposed commercial constructs:
- Base: committed monthly token pool + per-route baseline RPS
- Route SLO add-on: priced per route, guarantees p95 latency if reserved nodes prepaid
- Blackout reserve: prepay warm-node hours (non-refundable) to enable fast dedicated switch during scheduled events
- Upgrade: 72h automated upgrade if blackout reserve present; otherwise manual 5-day lead

Theo M: ops checklist:
1) feature-flag "enterprise_flex" toggled per-customer
2) per-route queueing & SLO metrics (p95/p99)
3) pre-warm API + capacity accounting
4) auto-throttle to baseline when reserved exhausted
5) alert: reserved < 10% remaining during blackout window

Ivy L: docs checklist: entitlements matrix, billing examples (pro-rata upgrade & blackout fees), AE term sheet template, FAQ for SLO credit calculation. i'll draft the page and AE email template.

Marcus P: i'll post a legal exhibit draft in #legal later today. include: reserved capacity definition, SLO credit formula, blackout activation terms, liability cap.

ops-bot: feature-flag created: "enterprise_flex" env=staging owner=product. dashboard tile queued.

billing-bot: created ticket BILL-6001 for upgrade API & pro-rata billing. assigned to eng-billing.

Carmen G: next steps: Theo (ops plan + pre-warm cost), Marcus (legal exhibit), Ivy (docs + AE playbook), billing (API). i'll run a 30m sign-off Friday after artifacts in thread. thanks :thumbsup:
